import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axes
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

# Create a boxplot for transaction amounts by transaction type, colored by fraud status
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', palette='coolwarm')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Transaction Amounts by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
